st: Who will win the robotaxi race? Elon Musk, or China with DriveGPT?

sec.t: ff.60.1 The Westworld of self-driving: SF
sec.p: Are we there yet? Like many technological developments, self-driving has seemed ready to conquer the roads for years. Some trends start slowly, then become the norm in no time (see electric vehicles).

Robotaxis. Tesla (at $182 today) is valued by ARK at $2,000 a share in 2027, with a final value equal to 3x today's Apple ($2.6T). Much of the market value is tied to robotaxi adoption ($613B in hypothetical revenue in 2027; Apple's revenue in 2022 was $394B).

sec.t: ff.60.3 More money for taxis, less for carmakers
sec.p: There's a section on self-driving in ARK Big Ideas 2023 too (yes, despite the rejection after 5 interviews with them, I'm particularly fond of Cathie).

Haomo.ai, a Chinese AI giant (a bit of culture on the non-US players driving progress), unveiled DriveGPT: the revolution of reinforcement learning from human feedback in self-driving (until now we knew RLHF only from ChatGPT and models that improved by chatting).

sec.t: ff.60.5 Fewer deaths on the roads?
sec.p: A road accident can pollute as much as 10 years of an average European's emissions (⛲ ff.58.3 Going to Niagara Falls (from New York)).

rel: ff.58 Do bananas pollute too much?
